description: Розрахунки за послуги з розподілу електроенергії is a dataset listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Дубенська міська рада. Інформація про розрахунки за послуги з розподілу електроенергії по ПрАТ "Рівнеобленерго". Coverage: Дубенська міська рада. The publisher named on the listing is Дубенська міська рада. Its keywords include дубенська міська рада, житлово-комунальні послуги, набор відкритих даних. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2021-06-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
